title: Write the user-facing copy
task_summary: Write the home introduction, empty states, and failure messages for the books app within its concise plain tone, accepted by brief and style review.

approved_outcomes.outcome: The home page introduction is written.
Empty states for the book list and for empty search results are written.
Messages for failed load and save operations are written.
The copy follows the app's concise, plain tone.
A maintainer review against the brief and style checklist is the acceptance.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver the interface copy set
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: One voice across all surfaces; per-surface splits lose tone consistency.

acceptance_evidence: Maintainer review against the brief and the style checklist; unit-test sections do not apply.
